newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed, bargain hunting likely.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed, bargain hunting likely.

text.p: The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) is likely to remain mixed on Tuesday, torn between selling and buyers snapping up issues which fell heavily in the previous session.
"We have got both buying and selling orders from retailers. Market may remain mixed," said broker Khurshid Alam.
He said blue chips in pharmaceuticals and cement sectors were likely to rise on retail buying while textile and engineering sectors could fall.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index dropped 37.93 points, or 4.21 percent, to 862.05 on Monday on turnover of 50 million taka.
